acceptance.given: Replay Result is successful and Validator Capability verification is independently performed.

oracle.expected: Replay Result records an independent Validator Capability verification tied to the same replay execution.
forbidden: Successful Replay Result lacks independent Validator Capability verification.
Verification is inferred solely from replay success.
oracle.observable: Replay evaluation artifact contains a Validator Capability verification record referencing the successful result and validated capability source.

acceptance.then: Persist and expose independently produced Validator Capability verification before success is accepted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Omit or mutate Validator Capability verification while leaving the replay result successful; validation must reject the result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each successful replay result to independently verify Validator Capability and bind that verification to the result before success acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay result schema; rollback removes only the additional capability-verification gate.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful replay lacks capability proof -> capability independently verified and bound to successful replay
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Replay success is accepted only when an independent Validator Capability verification artifact references the same replay result; missing, mismatched, or inferred proof fails.

acceptance.given: Witness validation runs against the complete frozen atomic-obligation set.

oracle.expected: Validation reports required witness coverage for 100% of atomic obligations with no missing witnesses and no orphan obligations.
forbidden: Any atomic obligation is missing a required witness.
Coverage is reported without checking every atomic obligation bidirectionally.
An orphan obligation is silently ignored.
oracle.observable: Exact-cover validation artifact enumerates every atomic obligation, required witnesses, and a zero-missing/zero-orphan summary.

acceptance.then: Emit a complete witness coverage report proving every atomic obligation has all required witnesses.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove a required witness or introduce an orphan atomic obligation in the validation fixture; exact-cover validation must report incomplete coverage.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Strengthen exact-cover witness validation to enumerate all atomic obligations and require complete bidirectional witness coverage with zero orphans.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing exact-cover result format; rollback only the stricter completeness assertion.

slice_hint.state_transition: Witness coverage unknown or incomplete -> validated 100% bidirectional coverage with zero orphans
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only when every atomic obligation maps to all required witnesses and every witness maps to an existing obligation; any gap or orphan fails.

acceptance.given: A target package is presented for acceptance or use.

oracle.expected: A distinct independent identity-verification result establishes the target package identity before any acceptance or use.
forbidden: Target package is accepted or used without independent identity verification.
Identity is inferred only from a caller-provided label or path.
oracle.observable: Verification result contains independently computed package identity and is referenced by the acceptance decision.

acceptance.then: Perform independent target-package identity verification and gate acceptance or use on that result.
acceptance.when: Before accepting or using a target package.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Substitute or alter the target package after identity verification; the acceptance path must reject the mismatched identity.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Independently compute and verify target package identity, then bind acceptance or use to the verified identity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing package formats and reject only when independently computed identity differs or is absent.

slice_hint.state_transition: Target identity unverified -> independently verified identity bound to package use
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No target package may be accepted or used unless independent identity computation matches package bytes and recorded target identity; mismatch or missing proof rejects.

acceptance.given: A foreign-authority case is supplied to success evaluation.

oracle.expected: The case receives a non-success verdict and success is rejected because authority does not match the current authority.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a foreign-authority case.
Foreign authority is ignored or treated as equivalent to current authority.
oracle.observable: Evaluation verdict records authority mismatch and a non-success status.

acceptance.then: Reject success whenever evaluation detects a foreign-authority binding.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Provide a case whose authority identifier differs from the current authority; success evaluation must return non-success.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add explicit authority-identity comparison to success evaluation and reject foreign-authority cases.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Maintain verdict schema and represent foreign authority as existing non-success outcome.

slice_hint.state_transition: Foreign-authority case presented -> authority mismatch detected -> non-success verdict
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success predicate is false whenever case authority differs from current authority; verdict must be non-success with mismatch evidence.
